limitations: Narrative/count/state QA only; no engine, hydraulic, collision, exact palette or animation-anchor validation.
All character appearances and room capacities are concept proposals.

findings.finding: Six cells give three distinct adult front/back pairs; Moren matches the two-bowls storyboard. Costume authority and personal appearance remain proposals.

One empty patient bed and exactly two bedside medicine bowls, only one visibly steaming. Closed cabinet, separate exchange table and unobstructed entrance support N7-S01. Incidental food vessel on exchange table is not an extra medicine dose.

Two empty cots in separate alcoves, covered central carrier trough and two closed case books are visible. No subjects, active fluid/beam, restraints or cure demonstration. Apparatus cabinet is visibly open, despite sealed-cabinet wording in prompt; pipe-to-cot endpoints and down/off handle state are not independently clear. Treat as inactive historical-investigation concept, not proof of a mechanically verified shutdown or exact sealed-access state. Outer corridor and central return exit read spatially; collision and gate states unverified.

Medicine, sealed private folio and paired comparison records remain separate. One key is visible; no legible patient names. Center chest is open but folio stays bound/sealed; right tokens became two locked boxes. Supports record separation, not exact requested token assets or a closed-cabinet state.

Four frames retain the same adult Moren, two bowls on one tray, one steaming bowl and an empty cot edge. Holding, lowering, releasing and standing beside tray are legible; no extra bowls or cure implication. Table/cot/figure geometry drifts, so storyboard only, not animation-ready anchors.

overall: No hard count or narrative-state contradiction found in selected review images. Preserve the explicit state/readiness caveats.
